description.value: At 4th, 9th, 14th, and 19th levels, a psychic gains the ability to use attack and defense modes, collectively called thinkmodes. The use of thinkmodes depends on her phrenic pool: some modes cost phrenic points to use; others are available whenever she has 1 or 2 points of phrenic pool. Select two thinkmodes each time she gains this ability — two defenses, two attacks, or one of each. Attack modes (Ego Whip, Id Insinuation, Mind Thrust, Psionic Blast, Psychic Crush) require a swift action to launch, with a save DC of 10 + half the psychic's level + her Intelligence modifier. Defense modes (Intellect Fortress, Mental Barrier, Mind Blank, Thought Shield, Tower of Iron Will) require a swift action to erect and remain in place until she erects a new one or sleeps/loses consciousness.
